# games-app
> 150+ browser games, Japanese learning suite, professional AI engines (Stockfish/KataGo/YaneuraOu), FastMCP 3.2 server, Tauri 2.0 desktop app.

## Quick Start
- [README](README.md): Overview, features, quick install
- [INSTALL](INSTALL.md): 5 install options (mcpb, manual, dev, Tauri NSIS)
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md): Release history

## MCP Server
- [Server source](games-mcp/src/games_mcp/server.py): FastMCP 3.2 instance with 13 tools across gameplay, analysis, management, orchestration
- [docker-compose](docker-compose.yml): Full stack gateway + Stockfish + Shogi + Go
- [Dockerfile](Dockerfile): Gateway container

## Webapp
- [App.tsx](web_sota/src/App.tsx): React 19 dashboard with 7 tabs
- [API client](web_sota/src/utils/mcp_client.ts): JSON-RPC + REST client
- [vite.config](web_sota/vite.config.ts): Vite 7 dev proxy config

## Desktop
- [Tauri config](native/tauri.conf.json): Tauri 2.0 NSIS config
- [main.rs](native/src/main.rs): Rust operator lifecycle
- [backend.rs](native/src/backend.rs): Backend spawn, port clear, readiness
